name: SubQuery Settings unprotected setBatchAddress
summary: Settings.setBatchAddress()/setContractAddress() lacked the onlyOwner modifier, so the attacker repointed the StakingManager and RewardsDistributor registry entries at their own helper, which then passed Staking's address-based authorization checks and moved the Staking proxy's 218M SQT out via unbondCommission()/withdrawARequest().
